crossRefs.note: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
crossRefs.keyword: boundaries of kingdoms and countries inviolable

crossRefs.note: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
crossRefs.keyword: boundaries of kingdoms and countries inviolable

crossRefs.note: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
crossRefs.keyword: boundaries of kingdoms and countries inviolable

crossRefs.note: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
crossRefs.keyword: boundaries of kingdoms and countries inviolable

crossRefs.note: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
crossRefs.keyword: boundaries of kingdoms and countries inviolable

translations.web: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.
translations.bsb: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess
translations.asv: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbor's landmark, which they of old time have set, in thine inheritance which thou shalt inherit, in the land that Jehovah thy God giveth thee to possess it.
